item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 31/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Saola will move towards the coast of eastern Guangdong in the next couple of days, edging closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary gradually. The weather over the coast of Guangdong will deteriorate. It will be windy with frequent heavy squally showers and storm surge. Seas will be high with swells. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be showers over the coast of southern China early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Haikui will move across the seas east of Taiwan and towards the coast of eastern China in the next couple of days.

Date/Month: 01/09 (Friday)
Wind: North to northwest force 6 to 7, becoming northeast force 9 to 10, up to force 12 offshore and on high ground later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times later. Seas will be high with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 30 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
